label: Version 1.3.7
releaseNotes: Builds each ICN directly from its Referral Number, so VA26S600001 or iFAMS26S600001 becomes TEST26S600001.
Supports selecting multiple stations and shuffles the selected station IDs across every referral in the generated batch.
Adds optional iFAMS prefixes for Referral Numbers, JSON files, and timestamped gzip archives.
Guarantees that generated Referral Numbers remain unique across the complete batch.
Makes the station selector and settings updates faster and smoother, and updates Electron to Version 44.
